lookupTypes.title: Application type
lookupTypes.description: Storefront vertical (Sarees, Groceries, Café). Saved on products as product_type_id (e.g. app_sr). Departments and categories are parented on these rows.

lookupTypes.title: Product departments
lookupTypes.description: Storefront departments; parent is an application_type row.

lookupTypes.title: Product categories
lookupTypes.description: Merchandising categories. Parent is a department or application_type. Code = URL slug for /browse/:categorySlug.

lookupTypes.title: Order fulfillment status
lookupTypes.description: Full order lifecycle (placed → delivered, cancelled, rejected). Vendor forms use in review–rejected only.
